content: Baro Harganchoy Paxis
Yesuusi zumaape wodhiya wode daro asay iya kaallidosona.
Heko issi baro harganchoy iyako shiiqidi, iya sinthan gulbatidi, “Godaw, ne shene gidiko tana geeshshada pathanaw danda7aasa” yaagis.
Yesuusi ba kushiya yeddidi iya bochidi, “Ee, ta shene, paxa” yaagis. Uray iiraka geeyi aggis.
Yesuusi iyako, “Ne paxuwa oodeska odopa. Shin bada ne geeyada paxoysa kahine bessa. Ne paxuwas marka gidana mela bada Musey kiitida yarshuwa yarsha” yaagis.
Mato Halaqa Ammano
Yesuusi Qifirnahooma katama gakida wode, issi mato halaqay iyako shiiqidi,
“Godaw, ta aylley asatethay gundin daro hargetidi, son zin7idi de7ees” yaagidi woossis.
Yesuusi zaaridi, “Taani bada iya pathana” yaagis.
Shin mato halaqay zaaridi, “Godaw, ne ta soo gelanaw bessiya asi gidike, shin ne han uttada qaala xalaala oda, ta aylley paxana.

Ayis giiko, taape bollara tana kiittiya asati de7oosona, qassi taape garsara taw kiiteteysati de7oosona. Entafe issuwa, ‘Ba’ giyade bees; hankuwa qassi ‘Haaya!’ giyade yees. Ta aylliya, ‘Haysa ootha’ giyade oothees” yaagis.
Yesuusi hessa si7ida wode malaaletidi, bana kaalliya asaako, “Ta hintew tuma odayis; taani haysa mela ammano Isra7eele asanka be7abike.
Ta hintew odayis; daroti dolohapenne wulohape yidi, salo kawotethan Abrahaamera, Yisaaqaranne Yayqoobara issife imato bolla uttana.
Shin salo kawotethaa laattanaw bessishin attidaysati kare dhuman holetana. Yan entaw yeehonne acha garcethi gidana” yaagis.
Yesuusi mato halaqaako, “Ne soo ba, ne ammanuwatho new hano” yaagis. Iya aylley iiraka paxi aggis.
Yesuusi Daro Harganchota Pathis
Yesuusi Phexroosa soo geliya wode, Phexroosa mache aayiya qoxo misha hargen saketada zin7idaaro be7is.
Yesuusi I kushiya bochida wode qoxoynne mishay aggaagis. Paxa dendada iya mokasu.
He wode omarsi tuna ayyaanan oyketida daro asata, asay Yesuusako ehidosona. Ika tuna ayyaanata ba qaalan kessis, harganchota ubbaa pathis.
Hessanka nabiya Isayaasi,
gida qaalay poletis.
Yesuusa Kaaloy Cigsiya Gate
Yesuusi daro asay iya yuushuwan eqidaysa be7idi, abbaafe hefinthi pinnana mela ba tamaareta kiittis.
Higge astamaaretape issoy, “Astamaariyaw, ne biya bessa ubbaa ta kaallana” yaagis.
Yesuusi iyako “Workanatas olli de7ees, salo kafotas keethi de7ees. Shin Asa Na7aas ba huuphiya shempisiya bessi baawa” yaagis.
Yesuusa kaalliya asatape issoy, “Godaw, taani sinthata bada ta aawa moogada yaana” yaagis.
Shin Yesuusi, “Hayqidaysati banta hayqota moogo; neeni tana kaalla” yaagis.
Yesuusi Hobbiya Seeris
Yesuusi baanaw wogoluwan gelida wode, iya tamaaretika iyara baanaw gelidosona.
Enti qoponna de7ishin, wolqaama hobbey haatha bolla dendin wogoloy mitettanaw gakis. Shin Yesuusi dhiskis.
Iya tamaareti iyako shiiqidi iya barkethidi, “Godaw, nu dhayos nuna ashsharki” yaagidosona.
Yesuusi entako, “Hinteno, ammanoy pacidaysato, ayis yayyetii?” yaagis. Dendidi, hobbiyanne gotiya essis. Ellesidi ubbabay si77i gis.
Iya tamaareti malaaletidi, “Haysi, hari attoshin, hobbeynne gotey kiiteteysi waanida asee?” yaagidosona.
Tuna Ayyaani Oykida Nam7u Asata

Yesuusi abbaafe hefinthan de7iya Gergesoone biitta gakida wode tuna ayyaanay oykida nam7u asati duufope keyidi iyara gahetidosona. Enti daro iitanne yashshiya asata gidiya gisho asi he bessaara aadhanaw danda7enna.
Entika, “Xoossaa Na7aw, nunanne nena aybe gathey? Wodey gakonna de7ishin nuna pirdanaw yadii?” gidi waassidosona.
Entafe daro haakonna guduntho wudey hemetees.
Tuna ayyaanati Yesuusa, “Ne nuna kessanaba gidiko, hini guduntho wudiya giddo yeddarki” yaagidi woossidosona.
Yesuusi, “Biite” yaagis. Tuna ayyaanati asatape keyidi gudunthotan gelidosona. Gudunthoti ubbay aafo doonara dirgidi bidi abban mitetidi hayqidosona.
Guduntho wudiya heemmeysati baqatidi katama bidi, hanidabaanne tuna ayyaanay oykida asata bolla oosetidaba ubbaa odidosona.
Yaatin, kataman de7iya asa ubbay Yesuusa be7anaw keyidosona. Enti Yesuusa be7ida wode banta biittafe keyidi baana mela woossidosona.
